# Notice

**Original work.** All assembly, Python, art and the bitmap font in this repository were written for this project. Art and font are generated by `tools/make_art.py`. No code was copied from the projects in [docs/PRIOR_ART.md](docs/PRIOR_ART.md); ideas taken from them are credited there.

**Tools used but not redistributed:** RGBDS, PyBoy, SameBoy (`make sameboy` clones it to an ignored directory), PyTorch, NumPy, Pillow, matplotlib, pytest. Each has its own licence.

**Trademarks.** Nintendo and Game Boy are trademarks of Nintendo. This is an unofficial, unaffiliated project and uses no Nintendo artwork or logos. The ROM header's required logo bytes are written by `rgbfix` for hardware compatibility, as for any homebrew ROM.
